title: Typing useEffect
description: Learn how to type useEffect cleanup and dependencies.

data.text: useEffect itself doesn't require explicit types, but the functions inside it often do. The key is typing cleanup functions correctly.

The useEffect hook runs after the DOM has updated. It takes a function and an optional dependency array. The function can contain side effects like data fetching, subscriptions, or manually changing the DOM.

data.title: useEffect

data.text: When a component unmounts or re-runs the effect, the previous cleanup function runs. This is where you cancel network requests, remove event listeners, or clear timers. TypeScript enforces that cleanup returns a function, not a value.

data.title: Cleanup
Return Type
data.text: useEffect's cleanup function must return void or a cleanup function. TypeScript enforces this automatically.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: useEffect typing is mostly about the functions inside it.
